note: The knobs of the lab's tuner, in its order. An axis here is ONE knob; an axis over several knobs is a later version of this file, not a second meaning for an id.

axes.positive_means: further down the list of sets: 0 the clone; 1 clone + elite; 2 clone + common + horde; 3 elite; 4 elite + common + two horde; 5 the six
axes.mechanics: LAB_WHO: which body slots are stood on their marks

axes.positive_means: heavier: a blow sends a body less far and throws it less high
axes.mechanics: L_HITR: divides a blow's speed and rise (with each body's own weight)

axes.what: how far a blow sends a body
axes.mechanics: L_HITR: multiplies the move's own speed (KNOCK_T)

axes.what: how high a launcher throws a body
axes.positive_means: higher (the rise is capped at LIFT_MAX whatever this is)
axes.mechanics: L_HITR: multiplies the move's own rise (LIFT_T)

axes.what: how long a blow holds a body
axes.mechanics: the fist's landing: multiplies the move's own frames

axes.what: the hitstop of a blow that lands
axes.positive_means: longer: the fight stands still for more frames
axes.mechanics: the fist's landing: multiplies the move's own hitstop and shake

axes.what: how far a sent body slides
axes.positive_means: farther: it keeps more of its speed each frame
axes.mechanics: the lab's bodies: the share of floor speed kept a frame

axes.what: how fast a thrown body falls
axes.mechanics: the lab's bodies: taken from their rise each frame

axes.what: how fast his body turns into a blow
axes.mechanics: steer_head: his BODY's turn toward the pad's way

axes.what: how far a strike carries him
axes.mechanics: the blow's drive: multiplies the move's own lunge

axes.what: how long a string stands after a blow
axes.mechanics: the string's count is kept this long

axes.what: how long a button is down before time slows
axes.positive_means: longer: slowed time is harder to enter
slower: one frame of the fight in this many
axes.mechanics: the fight's clock while a button is held
